card.title: Custom wallpaper
card.description: Sync wallpapers, rotation, and display effects
settings.sync: Synchronized by the server across browsers connected to this NexusPipeline instance.
settings.enabled_help: Use a custom wallpaper as the page background when enabled.
settings.secondary_help: When disabled, secondary overlays remain opaque while primary page cards keep the configured transparency.
settings.rotation_help: Time-based rotation changes the wallpaper at the configured interval; startup rotation selects once after the service starts.
settings.interval_help: Used by time-based rotation, from 1 to 1440 minutes.
settings.dim_help: Dim range: 0 to 80%, used to tune contrast between the wallpaper and content.
settings.transparency_help: Controls transparency for cards, the sidebar, and other surfaces, from 0 to 50%.
settings.file_help: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; 8192 KB per image
settings.max_help: Up to 32 images, 256 MiB per instance.
error.types: Wallpapers support JPEG, PNG, or WebP only
error.count: You cannot add more than 32 wallpapers
error.total: Wallpapers cannot exceed 256 MiB in total
error.image: The wallpaper content does not match its declared type
warning.portrait: This image may display poorly on a computer
warning.palette: Wallpaper uploaded; palette generation is pending: {error}
